title: IT Helpdesk FAQ
body: Common IT helpdesk requests: password/SSO resets (see the dedicated guide), VPN setup (see the VPN setup guide), new software requests (submit via the IT portal, most standard tools auto-approve), and laptop issues (loaner laptops available same-day from the IT desk on each floor). Helpdesk hours: 8am-6pm local time, Monday-Friday; urgent after-hours issues page the on-call support rotation.
